title: A finite flat algebra of rank one has bijective structure map
statement: Let A -> B be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that B is finite and flat as an A-module. If Module.rankAtStalk B = 1, then the structure map A -> B is bijective.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0ELZ (lemma-check-isomorphism-zariski), line 2265: the final 'pleasant exercise' that a locally free algebra of rank one is an isomorphism
